description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs: `general_name_matches` now uses the upstream-derived `PartialEq` on `GeneralName` for non-DN variants instead of DER-encoding both sides and comparing bytes. Eliminates two heap allocations per comparison. DN comparison still uses `names_match` (RFC 4518 string prep). Correct and cleaner.
title: Good: general_name_matches avoids DER re-encoding
